items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Dorsey -- of course I knew him, he used to come around. He's a fun guy. He's a happy guy.

ctx.x: What about the buffet flats, what were they like?

Well, a buffet flat was where you went to eat, drink. Some of them were bawdy houses, you know. And it could be any house, a house like this, an apartment. An apartment, an apartment like this. And the standing joke was you could go in almost any apartment house and knock on almost any door and get something to drink, you know. You'd knock on the door and they'd say, "Who's there?" "Jimmy sent me." You know, okay, and he'd crack the door and look at you, and the thing I always marveled at -- I went through too, I…
What about some of the other entertainers? Do you remember -- well, Gladys Bentley, for instance?
